name: PRAHA STREAM
description: A modern, source-agnostic streaming interface with a built-in stremio-addons.net browser, Stremio addon and Nuvio plugin repository support, multiple local profiles with custom display pictures, unified discovery, local libraries, and a responsive web player.
majorCapabilities: Stremio manifests, catalogs, search, metadata IDs, and streams
Stremio addon browser backed by the stremio-addons.net directory API
Multiple local profiles, each with a custom uploaded display picture
Nuvio repository manifests and worker-based scraper runtime
Persistent watchlist, history, sources, and per-profile preferences
